messages.subject: [GSoC-R] Melange Link_id?
parts:
Dear list,

The template for student applications [1] mentions the 'Melange Link_id' in
the CONTACT INFORMATION section. Do I understand correctly that Melange is
not used any more and is being replaced by new software for the GSoC? Does
that mean that Melange Link_id are obsolete?

If yes, that would probably be a good idea to remove it from the template.

Thanks,
Mathieu Basille.


[1] https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2016/wiki/application-template


--
